author: rory
notes: Two plan premises failed and were fixed in place. (1) The pin did not ride existing routes: forge-runtime's HTTP dispatch hardcoded Scope.as_of None and dropped PageInfo, so forge-runtime--step-ip4 adds the x-forge-as-of request/response pair and x-forge-has-more. (2) GET /api/v1/platform/openapi needs platform:read, which only SSO-federated bearers carry (forge-runtime-auth sso/authz.rs:21-23), so a workspace-local user (the identity the export is for) got 403; the CLI now falls back to the config tree's declared tables, probes each data route, and says so in manifest.tables_from. LANDING OWED and blocked: forge-runtime--step-ip4's pre-done fleet-check is red on IP-3's drift (cli-customer-commands@1, ledger-hosting-standing@2 grep the retired build alias); the fix is forge-facts--step-ip4-drift 1ee8227 + forge-platform-architecture--step-ip4-drift ece7da9, committed locally, 296/296 pins hold against them, outside the landing block so it waits on Rory. The CLI must not land without the runtime half: alone it refuses every workspace (no x-forge-as-of). Dev-stack orphans from failed evidence runs, to deprovision: ws-069bc968be1d3c94, ws-542a1e43b65f6717, ws-53ed9ad68c5a7c5b, ws-936ac8319ef413cf, ws-25c6620800cc4ff8, ws-9f94baf74ea0bb0e; ws-6f1f5f50fa9ebcda is the passing run's workspace.

verdicts.evidence: forge-cli src/cmd/export.rs; stub tests one_as_of_pins_every_page_and_each_row_is_written_once and an_identity_refused_the_openapi_document_exports_the_config_trees_tables (job ip4-fallback-2: 5 passed, clippy -D warnings clean); live manifest .harness/reports/ip4-devstack/export/manifest.json (as_of 507, rows 130/0, config_tree.git_sha 38ac89c6, dirty false, ip4_private note rls-denied (rls_default_deny), tables_from config tree). Runtime half: forge-runtime--step-ip4 dispatch.rs, tests/http_adapter.rs
verdicts.item: forge export --out <dir> writes <table>.jsonl for every routed table and a manifest.json carrying as_of, per-table row counts, the config tree's git sha, and per-table notes for RLS-denied, hidden and unrouted tables.
A forge-cli test against a stub server asserts one as_of is pinned across every page of a multi-page table, that rows are written exactly once, and that no platform or admin bearer is sent.

verdicts.evidence: .harness/reports/ip4-devstack/summary.json from .harness/reports/ip4-devstack.py (rc 0, 'PASS: every exported table equals GET /api/v1/data/{table} for the same identity'): CP-minted ws-6f1f5f50fa9ebcda on the lane runtime, exported through the TLS edge https://ws-6f1f5f50fa9ebcda.forge.run:8081 as workspace-local user reader@ip4.local (fr_u_, role user granted ip4_notes:read/ip4_private:read by a declared role); ip4_notes 130 export rows == 130 GET rows, all 130 owned by the caller out of 250 seeded (owner row_security), walked in 50-row pages at one as_of 507; ip4_private 0 == 0 with GET x-forge-rls rls_default_deny
verdicts.item: On the dev stack, exporting a seeded workspace yields rows equal to what GET /api/v1/data/{table} returns for the same identity, shown in the step's evidence.

verdicts.evidence: README.md command row and section 'forge export — your readable data as files' (exports what the caller's identity can read, and nothing else; neither of two users gets a backup; the platform:read fallback and tables_from)
verdicts.item: forge-cli README.md documents forge export and states plainly that it exports what the caller's identity can read.
